The left side shows the inside of the front cover with a clear plastic pocket containing a pink grid paper sheet with hand-drawn diagrams and text. The right side shows the back cover or another page. The metal ring mechanism is visible at the top center, holding the pages. The binder appears to be made of smooth plastic or vinyl.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the pink grid paper is nonsensical and malformed. Characters are distorted, merged, and lack legible structure, typical of AI-generated text artifacts. The diagram lines also show slight irregularities and bleeding.

artifact_observations.location: Top edge of the binder near the ring mechanism
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection between the metal rings and the binder spine/hinge area appears slightly ambiguous and soft. The geometry of how the rings attach to the cover is not perfectly crisp, suggesting minor structural ambiguity.

The right edge of the binder seems to curve or warp slightly unnaturally, and the thickness of the cover changes inconsistently along the edge, indicating minor perspective or geometric modeling issues.
